guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows emailservice disk I/O spiking to 9.6e9 (z≈9.6e15) with massive CPU and latency increases, while all other services show negligible changes. This extreme disk I/O anomaly in emailservice is the clear root cause of the system-wide latency and availability alert.

proposed_fix.description: Restart emailservice to clear the runaway disk I/O and CPU consumption, or investigate and fix the underlying disk write loop.
